newsitem.title: USA: Active Voice names Costa president, COO.
newsitem.headline: Active Voice names Costa president, COO.

text.p: Active Voice Corp said Frank Costa was appointed as president and chief operating officer, effective immediately.

Costa will report to chief executive officer Robert Richmond and will be responsible for all operations of the company, including engineering, sales, marketing, quality assurance, production and administration.

Costa has 20 years of marketing and senior management experience with technology companies, including Intel Corp and Mentor Graphics Corp. It was not immediately known if Costa's position was a newly formed job.
